summary: Join our comprehensive Mergers and Acquisitions training course to master the intricacies of finance. Equip yourself with the tools for success in the industry.
lede: Acquisition finance training covers how to assess the financial case for buying or combining businesses. It is for finance professionals involved in acquisition screening, transaction execution, investment approval, or post-merger value tracking. Participants practise quality-of-earnings analysis and normalized EBITDA bridges, build DCF valuations and merger models, and track synergies through post-close KPIs.
audienceIntro: This course suits finance professionals who support acquisition screening, transaction execution, investment approval, or post-merger value tracking. It is designed for foundation to intermediate learners who can work with financial statements and want a structured M&A finance workflow without requiring programming or investment banking experience.
modules: M&A Finance Foundations and Deal Logic
Financial Due Diligence and Earnings Quality
Investment Committee Reporting and Deal Roadmaps
prerequisites: Prior exposure to financial statements, management accounting, corporate finance, or budgeting is recommended. You should be comfortable with income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and basic spreadsheet formulas. No coding or programming is required. Advanced valuation, purchase accounting, tax structuring, and regulatory topics are taught at operational application level, while legal documentation and sector-specific regulatory analysis remain conceptual. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for the practical exercises.
